fomod.Name: Valhalla A Combat Survival Accord
fomod.Author: CageTV
fomod.Description: One mod installed in parts for Skyrim 1.5.97 to 1.7.104 (SE and AE): Survival Accord (Firmament perks for Last Seed 2026 and Frostfall 2026), a 1.7 build of Valhalla Combat with Stop On Slash, Elden Counter and Elden Parry built in, a 1.7 build of Archery Locational Damage, and a 1.7.104 DLL for DPF RE (Parry for All). Each part lists the mods it needs on its page. Licenses and source links are installed to Data\Licenses.
